elf_archer_attack._why_drop: Raw box 4 is the ARROW in flight, 147x23px of sliver sitting a full cell to the right of the frame that looses it. It is not a frame and it is not part of one: the projectile is spawned by the game, and baking it into frame 3 would inflate that frame's canvas by 190px of empty air, which build_player_frames pads into every one of the state's 8 frames.

elf_archer_cast._why_merge: Raw box 3 is the summoned bow materialising in frame 2 - detached from the elf on purpose, since the whole point of the pose is that the weapon is not in his hand yet. Two cores, one frame.
